act:undo.unknown: undoes nothing we can name: the chain ends there and its target isn't counted undone

act:use.unknown: rights null (matches nobody); undo falls back to your own rights

act:script.unknown: no sponsor: nothing runs on nobody's rights

act:sculpt.unknown: not exact: restore-before (refused if changed since)

act:*.unknown: no label match; an unknown chooser of an engine build is the owner's: never restamped

act:system.unknown: no rest link; no `onto` in the view; a lost body whose return names no home reads as back where it was picked up

act:create-world.unknown: marked: a purged founding never re-runs the repair

act:translated.unknown: marked: a purged translation never re-runs the repair

sim:launch.unknown: maybe in flight: no restamp; handled falls back to the launch's actor
